thread:
mira: quick rpc - should nuance flags live on the pin or in a separate timeline when we do canary->stable moves?

liam: separate timeline. avoids copying state on pointer changes.

sofia: agree. must return (model_ref, pointer_id, timeline_token) atomically so runtime doesn't mix generations.

mira: timeline_token opaque (e.g. tl-20260305-42). cache invalidation by token change.

liam: selector types: tenant, tag, percent. keep DSL tiny.

sofia: expiry + tombstone + redact paths for GDPR. redact keeps a tombstone record. purge via admin workflow.

mira: perf: resolver tuple fetch p95 <5ms, timeline lookup optional with header `X-Redwood-Flags: prefer=none`.

liam: audit header example: `X-Redwood-Resolve: model=acme/foo@v3;ptr=99;tl=tl-20260305-42`. nice and short.

sofia: compactor job to aggregate old entries, preserve monotonic token semantics. quotas on writes, metrics: timeline_writes, timeline_read_latency_ms.

mira: migration plan: one-shot move of inlined flags -> timeline, reversible for 48h.

devops-bot: scheduled_task: "timeline-compactor" next_run=3333080000 status=scheduled :spiral_calendar:

liam: i'll draft resolver openapi + cache rules.

sofia: i'll spec selector tests + quotas.

mira: i'll update RFC with append-only timeline model, redact/purge, audit header, and migration checklist.
